originality.rationale: The full six-residue coefficient polynomial, all eight seed families, and optimal-multiplicity census are not stated by inspected primary sources. Prior three-row odd-domination minima and the seed recurrence are excluded, as are general graph Lights Out solvability and fixed-length algorithmic computability. Inaccessible and unindexed equivalent enumerations are substantive residual risks.
residual_risks: Prior source Caro–Klostermeyer (2003) already gives the exact six minimum values and recurrence; novelty is only the *complete* coefficientwise distribution and counts of attaining sets.
The full text of Goldwasser–Klostermeyer–Ware (2002) was inaccessible; abstract is not adequate to exclude an unindexed six-class weight table.
The coefficient formula can be derived by an eight-seed table from a published recurrence, so it is an incremental complete classification rather than a new general method.
Unindexed or later mathematical notes or solver databases may give equivalent coefficients.

value.rationale: The weight generating polynomial of *all* solutions is a motivated natural invariant of the classical Lights Out optimization puzzle. Published prior work provides only the scalar minimum for each width3 strip; the complete classification distinguishes precisely six optimal strategies and two heavier in one residue class, two minima and two heavier in another, and unique solutions elsewhere. It supplies exact multiplicities for arbitrary lengths and a concrete periodic solution description without asserting a general theorem.
